units.source_text: 完全像是在这山上温泉“定居”的阿清，同上游的新旅馆的老板，多少形成了绝妙的对照。

en.t: Aqing, who seemed to have settled permanently at this mountain hot spring, made a rather striking contrast with the owner of the new inn upstream.

units.source_text: 他像一个拐卖妇女的贩子，从一个建筑工地到另一个建筑工地，所到之处都经营这行当。

en.t: Like a trafficker in women, he went from one construction site to another, carrying on the same business wherever he went.

units.source_text: 温泉旅馆的客人还在穿单衣，他就穿起棉袍来了。

en.t: While the guests at the hot spring inn were still wearing unlined robes, he had already put on a padded cotton robe.
